meta.author: self
meta.note: 全部自撰，不复制任何真题原文

items.zh: 中国的城市化进程在过去几十年里明显加快。
items.reference: The process of urbanization in China has accelerated significantly over the past few decades.
hints: 得分点：城市化进程 / 加快 / 明显地 / 在过去几十年里
「加快」可用 accelerate / speed up；「过去几十年」常与现在完成时连用
句型：The process of urbanization … has accelerated significantly over the past few decades.

items.zh: 越来越多的农村人口涌入城市寻找更好的工作机会。
items.reference: An increasing number of rural residents are flooding into cities in search of better job opportunities.
hints: 得分点：越来越多的 / 农村人口 / 涌入城市 / 寻找 / 更好的工作机会
「涌入」可用 flood / pour into；「寻找」可用 in search of（介词短语）或 look for（动词）
句型：An increasing number of … are flooding into cities in search of better job opportunities.

items.zh: 城市的快速发展带来了交通拥堵和住房紧张等一系列问题。
items.reference: The rapid development of cities has brought about a series of problems, including traffic congestion and housing shortages.
hints: 得分点：城市的快速发展 / 带来了 / 一系列 / 交通拥堵 / 住房紧张
「带来（结果）」用 bring about / lead to / give rise to；congestion 为不可数名词
句型：The rapid development of cities has brought about a series of problems, including …

items.zh: 高层建筑在大城市随处可见，改变了城市的天际线。
items.reference: High-rise buildings can be seen everywhere in big cities, changing the skyline of the city.
hints: 得分点：高层建筑 / 随处可见 / 在大城市 / 改变天际线
「随处可见」可用 can be seen everywhere；现在分词短语可作结果状语
句型：High-rise buildings can be seen everywhere in big cities, changing the skyline of the city.

items.zh: 为了方便市民出行，市政府正在大力修建地铁线路。
items.reference: In order to make it convenient for citizens to travel, the city government is vigorously building subway lines.
hints: 得分点：为了 / 方便…… / 正在大力修建 / 地铁线路
「使某人方便做」用 make it convenient for sb. to do，it 为形式宾语；「大力」用 vigorously
句型：In order to make it convenient for citizens to travel, the city government is vigorously building …

items.zh: 随着城市规模的扩大，耕地面积正在逐年减少。
items.reference: As cities expand in size, the area of farmland is decreasing year by year.
hints: 得分点：规模扩大 / 耕地面积 / 正在减少 / 逐年
「扩大」用 expand / grow；「逐年」为 year by year，注意与 year after year 的区别
句型：As cities expand in size, the area of farmland is decreasing year by year.

items.zh: 城市生活节奏快，竞争激烈，但也提供了更多的机会。
items.reference: Life in cities is fast-paced and competition is fierce, but it also offers more opportunities.
hints: 得分点：城市生活 / 节奏快 / 竞争激烈 / 提供更多的机会
「快节奏的」用 fast-paced；「激烈的（竞争）」用 fierce 或 intense
句型：Life in cities is fast-paced and competition is fierce, but it also offers more opportunities.

items.zh: 许多城市正在建设智慧城市，以提高城市的管理效率。
items.reference: Many cities are building smart cities so as to improve the efficiency of urban management.
hints: 得分点：正在建设 / 智慧城市 / 以 / 城市的管理效率
「智慧城市」为 smart city；「提高效率」用 improve / raise the efficiency of
句型：Many cities are building smart cities so as to improve the efficiency of urban management.

items.zh: 解决交通拥堵问题需要政府、企业和市民的共同努力。
items.reference: Solving the problem of traffic congestion requires the joint efforts of the government, enterprises and citizens.
hints: 得分点：解决……的问题 / 交通拥堵 / 需要 / 共同努力
动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 requires；「共同的／联合的努力」用 joint / combined efforts
句型：Solving the problem of … requires the joint efforts of …

items.zh: 与大城市相比，中小城市的生活成本相对较低。
items.reference: Compared with big cities, the cost of living in small and medium-sized cities is relatively low.
hints: 得分点：与……相比 / 生活成本 / 中小城市 / 相对较低
「生活成本」固定为 the cost of living；「中小型的」用 small and medium-sized
句型：Compared with big cities, the cost of living in … is relatively low.

items.zh: 大量的外来务工人员为城市建设作出了重要贡献。
items.reference: A large number of migrant workers have made important contributions to urban construction.
hints: 得分点：大量的 / 外来务工人员 / 为……作出了重要贡献 / 城市建设
「作出贡献」用 make contributions to，to 是介词；「务工人员」可用 migrant workers
句型：A large number of migrant workers have made important contributions to urban construction.

items.zh: 城市规划者应当注重保护历史街区，以保持城市的独特风貌。
items.reference: Urban planners should attach importance to protecting historical blocks so as to preserve the unique character of the city.

keyPoints.head: the unique character of the city
synonyms: the unique features of the city

hints: 得分点：城市规划者 / 注重 / 保护历史街区 / 以 / 城市的独特风貌
attach importance to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词；「保持／保存」用 preserve
句型：Urban planners should attach importance to protecting … so as to preserve …

items.zh: 随着城市人口的增加，对公共服务的需求也在不断上升。
items.reference: As the urban population grows, the demand for public services is also rising continuously.
hints: 得分点：城市人口 / 增加 / 对……的需求 / 公共服务 / 也在上升
「对……的需求」用 the demand for；population 作主语时谓语可用单数
句型：As the urban population grows, the demand for public services is also rising continuously.

items.zh: 社区公园为居民提供了休闲娱乐的好去处。
items.reference: Community parks provide residents with good places for relaxation and entertainment.
hints: 得分点：社区公园 / 为居民提供 / 好去处 / 休闲娱乐
「为某人提供某物」用 provide sb. with sth.；「休闲」可用 relaxation / leisure
句型：Community parks provide residents with good places for relaxation and entertainment.

items.zh: 为了解决住房问题，政府正在大力推进保障性住房建设。
items.reference: In order to solve the housing problem, the government is vigorously promoting the construction of affordable housing.
hints: 得分点：为了 / 解决住房问题 / 正在大力推进 / 保障性住房建设
「推进」可用 promote；「经济适用／保障性住房」用 affordable housing
句型：In order to solve the housing problem, the government is vigorously promoting the construction of …

items.zh: 夜间经济发展迅速，为城市增添了新的活力，也创造了更多就业岗位。
items.reference: The night-time economy has developed rapidly, adding new vitality to the city and creating more jobs.
hints: 得分点：夜间经济 / 发展迅速 / 为……增添新的活力 / 创造更多就业岗位
两个并列结果可用 and 连接的现在分词短语；「活力」用 vitality
句型：The night-time economy has developed rapidly, adding new vitality to … and creating more jobs.

items.zh: 便利的交通和完善的基础设施是城市吸引人才的重要因素。
items.reference: Convenient transportation and well-developed infrastructure are important factors for a city to attract talent.
hints: 得分点：便利的交通 / 完善的基础设施 / 重要因素 / 吸引人才
「完善的／发达的」可用 well-developed；「人才」可用 talent（不可数）或 skilled people
句型：Convenient transportation and well-developed infrastructure are important factors for a city to attract talent.

items.zh: 城市化的推进使越来越多的人享受到现代化的生活方式。
items.reference: The advancement of urbanization has enabled an increasing number of people to enjoy a modern lifestyle.
hints: 得分点：城市化的推进 / 使……能够 / 越来越多的人 / 现代化的生活方式
enable sb. to do 表示「使某人得以做」；「生活方式」可用 lifestyle 或 way of life
句型：The advancement of urbanization has enabled an increasing number of people to enjoy a modern lifestyle.

items.zh: 与此同时，城市也面临着环境污染和资源短缺的挑战。
items.reference: At the same time, cities are also faced with the challenges of environmental pollution and resource shortages.
hints: 得分点：与此同时 / 面临着 / ……的挑战 / 环境污染 / 资源短缺
「面临」可用 be faced with / be confronted with；pollution 与 shortage 此处均可数/不可数灵活处理
句型：At the same time, cities are also faced with the challenges of … and …

items.zh: 只有实现城乡协调发展，才能让发展成果惠及全体人民。
items.reference: Only by achieving coordinated development between urban and rural areas can the fruits of development benefit all the people.
hints: 得分点：只有通过 / 实现协调发展 / 城乡之间 / 发展成果 / 惠及全体人民
only + 介词短语置于句首时主句部分倒装；「惠及」可用 benefit（及物动词）
句型：Only by achieving … can the fruits of development benefit all the people.
